effective_condition: This bounded recruitment authorization becomes effective only when the reviewed Stage A recruitment authorization pull request containing this record is merged into main. Draft or ready-but-unmerged state grants no authority.
authorized_scope: identify up to 10 invite-ready candidates from relevant public work or the founder's existing network without scraping or retaining unnecessary identity data
prepare a pseudonymous candidate shortlist containing at most 10 records
send at most 10 individually reviewed personalized initial invitations and at most one follow-up per candidate
onboard at most 3 voluntary unpaid Stage A participants
collect only eligibility and task-submission information and record consent under pseudonymous participant IDs
retain only the minimal recruitment records authorized by the participant; experimental evidence retention remains separately pending
human_decision_required: whether to merge this bounded Stage A recruitment authorization; participant-task execution, experimental evidence retention, model or AEG use, Stage B, result publication, and experience promotion each still require separate recorded approval
